title: Harmonic diagnosis response
description: The structured answer the GenAI layer must return for a machine-health event. Enforced as a Vertex response_schema and re-validated on arrival, because a schema the provider applied is not evidence the content is grounded.

diagnosis.description: What is wrong with the machine, in one or two sentences a maintenance engineer can act on.

confidence.description: Confidence in the diagnosis. Below 0.4 the pipeline discards the answer and returns 'insufficient evidence - recommend manual inspection' instead: a confident-sounding guess is worse than an admission of ignorance.

root_causes.description: Why the failure mode arose, ordered most to least likely. Drawn from the graph's Cause nodes, not invented.

actions.description: Ordered work steps. This is the deliverable: free text is not actionable.

safety.description: Precautions before the work starts. Never empty: at minimum the lockout/tagout requirement. Harmonic is advisory, so the safety text is the whole of its contribution to the engineer's safety.

references.description: ManualSection ids backing the answer. Must be a SUBSET of the chunk ids retrieved for this event; rag/guard.py rejects anything else. This is the anti-hallucination boundary.

rul_hours.description: Remaining useful life in hours. A heuristic from the health-index slope, not a physics model, and labelled as such wherever it is shown.

failure_mode_id.description: The FailureMode node id this diagnosis corresponds to, when one applies. Lets the dashboard highlight the graph path.
